hookups.source: town campground page ('Our campsites do not offer electric hook-ups. The closest campground with electric is Matterhorn'; 'Water is available for on-site campers only via spigot (you must have your own hose)'; 'There is no dump station in the campground'), archived 2026-03-11

values.note: 28 vehicle sites (14 Premium on the perimeter or river, 14 Standard in the interior) plus 5 walk-in tent sites. No unit may exceed 30 ft, bumper to bumper or tongue to bumper; sites come in 30, 25 and 20 ft lengths and each has its own limit, which the town does not list per site. Slide-outs not recommended at every site.

sites.source: town campground page ('No single unit (bumper to bumper) OR unit (tongue to bumper) can exceed 30' in length; please note that site size restrictions apply. Individual campsites have vehicle size restrictions specific to site layout and size'; 'the site length will not decrease (30', 25', 20')') + its campground map (vehicle sites 1-28, Standard vs Premium, five named tent sites), archived 2026-03-11

facilities.source: town campground page ('Restroom/Shower Facility - all-in-one facility on-site includes restrooms, showers, dishwashing station, trash and recycling. Shower Facility is Token Operated'; water spigot; 'no dump station in the campground, arrangements must be made with the Waste Water Treatment Plant'), archived 2026-03-11

values.note: 2026 season May 15 - October 4. During festivals (Bluegrass mid-June, Jazz early August, Blues and Brews mid-September and others) the campground is run by the festival and open only to festival pass holders.

season.source: town campground page ('Campground Season Dates: May 15, 2026 - October 4, 2026'; '2026 Campground Blackout Dates ... The festivals will be managing the campground during these times'), archived 2026-03-11

values.note: Online only, in four booking windows opening at 9 a.m. MT (2026: April 21, May 19, July 7, August 18), each for a block of arrival dates; peak dates sell out within minutes. 7 nights in any 30-day period and 14 nights a season per person; one site per person per day, no group bookings. Give the true vehicle length when booking: the system may move you to another site of the same type and length class. Online pre-check-in required, then check in on site 3-9 p.m.; check-out 2 p.m.

booking.source: town campground page (booking-window table; 'Maximum Night Stay is seven (7) nights in a 30-day period/individual'; 'Maximum number of nights/season not to exceed 14 total nights'; 'despite the group booking option displaying prior to checkout in Campspot, only one site per individual per day is allowed'), archived 2026-03-11

values.note: Standard vehicle site $44, Premium $55 a night; seniors 63+ $36 / $45 with the promo code on the Campspot page. Plus a $3.50 booking fee.

fees.source: town campground page rate table (Premium '$55.00/night $45.00/night (Senior 63+)'; Standard '$44.00/night $36.00/night (Senior 63+)'; '(Do not include $3.50 booking fee)'), archived 2026-03-11

note: Town of Telluride municipal campground between the San Miguel River and Bear Creek, walkable to downtown. A 23-ft rig needs a 25- or 30-ft site. Dump before arriving (the town's wastewater plant takes RV waste by arrangement only). Generators 3-6 p.m. only; charcoal grills, no wood fires; no idling over 30 seconds in town. --Claude
summary: Town campground page (live domain down; read the 2026-03-11 archive + map): 28 vehicle sites (14 premium, 14 standard) + 5 tent, 30-ft unit limit incl. tow, sites in 30/25/20-ft classes. Confirmed electric 0, 28 sites, 30 ft, fcfs never, max 7. Added water/sewer false, pull-through false, season 05-15 to 10-04, platform Campspot, showers/flush toilets/water, fees $44-55 + $3.50 booking fee. Note: dropped the unsourced '10 fit larger RVs', the 'dump at Society Turn' (page: wastewater plant by arrangement) and the facts now in fields.
flags: Fit for a 23-ft motorhome: the town gives a 30-ft limit for the unit including any tow vehicle and sorts sites into 30, 25 and 20 ft length classes, but does not say how many sites are in each; the old note's '10 fit larger RVs' had no source and was dropped. Campspot's site list could not be read (the town's Campspot link was 'coming soon' in the archived page and the slug is not published).
